UPDATE SEP 2, 2024.

Hi. It's time we had a one-sided chat. 
At this point, I haven't played the game in a few weeks, ever since that abomination of an update called Escalation of Freedom reared its ugly head. 

I've been playing almost every day for months now. I've seen warbond after warbond come out with disappointing weapons, lackluster armor, and nonsense nerfs that were needed because it seems players were having too much fun. 

"Hey, the Illuminate are coming!" it's been on the horizon for MONTHS now. What do we get? Stronger bugs, less effective weapons, and a bunch of surprised Pikachu faces when people don't like it. ARROWHEAD, PLEASE, IT'S NOT TOO LATE. 

Your players are leaving in droves. You're really telling me that a unanimously negative change you implemented can't be undone and needs TWO MONTHS to fix?

I'm taking a break for now. I've had enough, because as a player, I feel disrespected and disappointed. I'm *tired* of defending this game, of getting people back in to play. 

It pains me, but I'm changing my review to negative until such time that I feel the situation has improved. 

Until then, lycka till. 

----------------------------------------------
I'm going to skip the usual "FOR SUPER EARTH" and "FREEDOM THROUGH MANAGED DEMOCRACY" screams for just a few seconds to give you my impression of this game.

I once likened it to a cross of Starship Troopers and Dance Dance Revolution. You read that right.
While you move across the procedurally generated levels of the worlds in many different mission types, you are calling in tactical equipment and airstrikes in the form of stratagems. These require you to input a series of arrows in order to activate the orb, before you throw it like a grenade. Somewhere else I saw this game referred to as "Airstrike Jutsu".

It's massive amounts of fun. The tutorial will teach you basic movements, but I strongly advise that you look into the control layout, as there are many things that it doesn't mention, like holding R to access the weapon's firing modes and flashlight settings.

As of writing this review, we have just wiped the terminator/WH40k Automatons off the face of the galaxy, only for them to return in full force in an ambush that most people saw coming, but we were still unsure of exactly how it was going to come about. Meanwhile, on the other front, the war against the Terminids, basically lifted from Starship Troopers, rages on, and the threat of a new enemy faction is on the horizon. It's tons of fun.

As for progression - you only need to reach level 25 to unlock access to all stratagems, which must then be bought with resource units. You cannot buy them, you have to just play the game. The higher the difficulty, the more the reward in XP, resource points, and medals (needed to unlock new weapons and armors) increases. Warbond medals are also gained from completing a daily challenge, and by all players globally working together to complete a major order that has a time-limit of a few days. Other players can help you achieve your daily missions as well, as progress is counted for the entire team.

Is there a paid currency in this live service game? Yes. Do you need to spend any money to get it? No!
Super credits can be found across most of the missions if you explore off the beaten path. It is thoroughly possible to grind the currency while you play normally. 1000 SC buys you access to a premium warbond, which contains armors, weapons, grenades and cosmetics that you can buy with the warbond medals earned through successful missions.
There is also a rotating offer of helmets and armors in the "super store", but these are mostly of cosmetic nature and have the same bonuses as armors that you can unlock for free, giving no immediate gameplay advantage.

Speaking of advantages, I bought the Super Citizen edition. It contains the a unique player title, the first warbond, a unique cape and armor set (same stats as a page 4 armor on the free warbond), and a one-handed SMG. The weapon and armor are good to get you started, but do not provide a pay2win advantage. I still use the helmet and cape (these are all cosmetic), but have since dropped the rest in favor of bigger and better weapons and a light armor.

The devs are incredibly good at interacting with the momentum of the community. If they place a challenge too hard, chances are that the next one might be a tiny bit easier to boost morale, and there is always an in-game explanation for it.

Speaking of the story, there isn't really much. If you are looking for an immersive single player experience, Helldivers 2 is not the game for you. The story in Helldivers develops through news snippets, in-game propaganda videos, and hints dropped by the devs. There are plenty of Youtube channels that give weekly summaries as well if you don't feel like seeking it yourself.
It's most fun played with friends, laughing at how you just got blown to smithereens by your own teammates by accident, and working together to get the job done. You *can* play missions solo, but I wouldn't advise it as the only mode of gaming. There are many other players looking for help, and you can join at any time during a mission.

After the tutorial, you will take command of your own Super Destroyer starship, which you can name from a list of combinations. Mine is named the Will of Democracy, but combinations like Patriot of Patriotism or Superintendent of Family Values are available if that's your thing.

I don't have much left to say, other than I can wholeheartedly recommend it. It's a fantastic game, lots of fun, and engaging.

Edit 4.29.26

My sweet summer child, it is time again. Its been 6 months and it went from tolerable trash to bad again. With all the new games I about to uninstall the first time since the 60 (+3) day patch.

Edit 9.23.25

Almost a year later and they are suffering from the same mistakes they corrected from previously, but even worse. They clearly have no proper leadership in house to whip their cocky know it all attitudes into shape to fix the problems they have along with one's they've had since launch and since the 60 day plan correction. Its obvious they are out sourcing to devs who don't have their core spirit or design plan (just look at the dragon roach and war strider). And they won't speak about it openly or right those wrongs. I love this game but it's time for another break until heads are firmly removed from asses and they fix the game like fans demand, new content be damned.

Edit 10.4.24

They fixed it. They listened to the players and buffed (or reverted the nerfs) weapons and a lot of functions back to enjoyable levels. No more failure space fake milsim nonsense. Its good again.

Edit 8.7.2024

CEO steps down to CCO and says nerfs will stop because we want the game to be fun. Some great buffs happen then the entire country of Sweden goes on vacation. When they return, all is forgotten and nerfs happen again. Not to mention fire related nerfs before a fire warbond drops. And they continue to defend these nerfs despite telling fans nerfs would stop. These guys are either retarded or full of ♥♥♥♥. Either way, I am sick of it. Please stop ruining this beautiful game ffs.

Edit 5.6.2024

Snoy did the right thing and walked back the dumb psn linkage (for now) so this game is back to being wonderful, mostly. See below my original positive review, but I am leaving the negative writeup below as it is still important and the nonsense from the community managers is still an issue.

Edit 5.5.2024

I was annoyed by some of the recent patches, but was able to look past that.
I was then further annoyed by the behavior by some of the so called community managers in response to the communities complaints about recent patches, as well as bugs barely being even repaired. We can probably chalk that up to ridiculous pressure from Snoy to just push out more product (warbonds, etc).
Then, on a Friday in a rather pathetic attempt to slide in some knowingly infuriating news as Friday is the day news goes to die, Snoy releases a statement about now suddenly requiring linking of PSN account or suffer banishment from the game I paid money for, and have spent more money on.
No alternatives to opt out and avoid cross play, no other solutions, comply or die, say Snoy. 
Then came even worse emotional reacts from the so called community managers, berating and insulting the offended community, including those who will be banned from playing because PSN is not offered in their country. But they didn't care about that when they offered the game for sale to people in those countries, they being Snoy, not the so called community managers.
Further, these community managers seemed to embrace the fact that this PSN link will permit them to ban more, and more easily and provide a "safer" game. What?
That sounds more like community activists to me who are now crying because people are in an uproar about this sudden requirement, especially from Baskinator who seemed to rejoice at the reaction she "knew was going to receive". 
So, at this point, I am ready to walk away from this game altogether and will certainly be leaving my negative review just from the emotional reaction and complete lack of professionalism from those who are supposed to be hired for their professionalism regarding the handling of a games community. Unless the leadership handles these failure employees as proper leadership should, and if not fired certainly no longer active in these roles they clearly cannot handle.
Now add to that Snoy clearly made some deals with the dev team and ceo that he admits about on twitter, knowing about this psn link 6 months prior to launch. He then thought instead of figuring out the link requirement it would be a good idea to just turn it off, allow skipping, and never mentioning the so called requirement ever again. Interesting strategy.
Frankly, had I known Snoy owned this game, I would not have gotten on board. I am tired of AAA on top of games that require additional accounts. I am over it, AAA, and corporation nonsense in my games, not to mention politics and wokeness, but outside of the so called community managers this game seemed to be free of that. 
So now, we have Snoy who got their money from people who will be unable to play this game, and AH who got their good ratings and performance for 3 months at the expense of the rest of us, and everyone deserves the negative treatment and reviews for selling us this spoiled dish.

I will be happy to amend my negative review and switch over to a positive one once Snoy chills out and provides alternatives to PSN linking/opting out, AH fixes its broken community managers and starts responding to its community in a professional manner, and I can keep playing this game without being held hostage by Snoy. I will continue to enjoy the memory of this game until I am banned by Snoy for noncompliance (to something that they previously had listed as optional and have since changed their website hoping no one would catch it) and then I will request a refund as I was sold a game that later had changes made to it that I no longer would have originally agreed with or to. But hopefully smarter heads prevail and all of this can go away and the world can continue playing without the boot of Snoy being stupid.
